sections.text: Leans back before thrusting at the player in a 7-meter-long attack with no arc (110 Pierce, 100 Tier 0 Chop and 100 Tier 0 Pickaxe damage). This attack can be used every 8 seconds when within 6 meters of a player.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Stone Golems are unable to climb sheer cliffs or follow narrow paths. Therefore, cutting a switchback trail up the mountainside is an effective defense against them while also allowing you access to the mountaintop.
• Stone Golems when they awake from their slumber will cause nearby players' screens to shake

sections.text: • Stone Golems have an unused attack labelled "Sonic boom" where they draw back both arms before lunging forward to attack. It is unknown whether this would have been added to sledge Golems, spiked Golems, or possibly both.

Introduction. Stone Golems are aggressive creatures found in the Mountains. They are snow-covered stone humanoids with silver veins visible on their bodies. When disturbed, they awake from their slumber, attacking both the players and other creatures.

Attacks and abilities. Stone Golems come in two variants: half of them are equipped with sledges, while the other half have spikes.
Sledge Golems have two attacks.

Ground slam. Raises one sledge arm up, before slamming it down into the ground (110 Blunt, 100 Tier 0 Chop and 100 Tier 0 Pickaxe damage). The attack extends 8 meters outward in a 70-degree vertical arc. It has an 8-second cooldown.

Double smash. Raises both sledge arms up, holds for a moment, and slams them both into the ground (110 Blunt, 100 Tier 0 Chop and 100 Tier 0 Pickaxe damage). The attack extends 8.66 meters outward in a 70-degree vertical arc. It has an 8-second cooldown.
Spiked Golems have two attacks.

Spike. Leans back before thrusting at the player in a 7-meter-long attack with no arc (110 Pierce, 100 Tier 0 Chop and 100 Tier 0 Pickaxe damage). This attack can be used every 8 seconds when within 6 meters of a player.

Spike sweep. Draws its spike back before slashing it in a 7.71-meter 104.24-degree horizontal arc (110 Blunt, 100 Tier 0 Chop and 100 Tier 0 Pickaxe damage). This can be used every 15 seconds when within 6 meters of a player.

Notes. • Stone Golems are unable to climb sheer cliffs or follow narrow paths. Therefore, cutting a switchback trail up the mountainside is an effective defense against them while also allowing you access to the mountaintop.
• Stone Golems when they awake from their slumber will cause nearby players' screens to shake
• Stone Golems cannot destroy Obsidian deposits and Silver veins in their mountain biomes.
• Stone Golens are enemies of Drakes, making baiting them into each other a valid strategy to obtain Crystals early on

Trivia. • Stone Golems have an unused attack labelled "Sonic boom" where they draw back both arms before lunging forward to attack. It is unknown whether this would have been added to sledge Golems, spiked Golems, or possibly both.
